content: Triggering behavior of event chains Type: valid Description: The AUTOSAR templates shall provide the means to describe the triggering behavior (e.g. periodic, sporadic, and arbitrary) of event chains. Rationale: The analysis and validation of an event chain's timing constraints requires to make assumptions about the occurrence characteristics of the according stimulus and response events. 5 14 of 34  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 410: AUTOSAR_RS_TimingExtensions Requirements on Timing Extensions AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00004] Supporting Material: None
